d:
A hunched, humanoid demon with slimy, olive green skin and a bloated, sagging torso. The eyes are small, milky white, and devoid of pupils. The build is asymmetrical and distorted, with long, spindly arms ending in three sharp talons. It possesses a short, stubby, fleshy tail and small, vestigial horns protruding from a sagging brow.
BODY COLOR: olive green
